'''Mil Stanner''' was a [[Human]] [[Gender|male]] [[spice]] [[smuggler]] specialist. In the past he had been betrayed many times and maintained some distance from people, although he kept an easygoing and friendly demeanor.

Stanner operated out of [[Vergesso Base]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Unlike most smugglers, he refused to carry cargo larger than small, precious objects and preferred working with spice, and his [[light freighter]], the ''[[Starlight Shifter]]'', had hidden compartments for that purpose.
